title: Nezha Zhi Mo Tong Nao Hai
synopsis:
After a tumultuous battle, Nezha and Ao Bing have survived—at the cost of their physical bodies. Without a corporeal vessel, their spirits are set to dissipate, and Taiyi Zhenren works to craft them new bodies. But when a mishap occurs during the crafting process, Ao Bing is left without a body and forced to share space within Nezha.

The only hope to craft a new body for Ao Bing is for Nezha to pass a test and be recognized by the Chang Sect, which would earn him immortality and a magical relic of his choosing. With his demonic origins a closely guarded secret, the two friends must carefully coordinate to pass without using any powers that might arouse suspicion. However, as the test goes on, it becomes apparent that not everyone's intentions are as benevolent as they seem.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
